hooks.command: sh -c 'for d in "$SECOND_BRAIN_KB" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/../knowledge-base" "$HOME/knowledge-base" "$HOME/code/knowledge-base"; do if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -x "$d/second-brain" ]; then export SECOND_BRAIN_KB="$d"; exec "$d/second-brain" hook session-start; fi; done; exit 0'
